setups.empty: No users or documents. Stub the UUID generator to the fixture document ID.
setups.empty-document: Alice owns the fixture document with last_sequence 0 and no changes.
setups.one-change: Alice owns the fixture document with last_sequence 1 and the stored envelope.
setups.two-changes: The one-change setup followed by second_envelope at sequence 2.
setups.foreign-document: Alice owns document_id at cursor 0; dev-bob owns foreign_document_id at cursor 0. Both logs are empty.
setups.gap: Alice owns the fixture document with last_sequence 2 but only second_envelope at sequence 2 exists.
setups.one-change-local-high-water-two: The one-change setup; the client has merged cursor 1 and observed high-water 2.
setups.production: The empty setup with APP_ENV production, even with DEV_AUTH true.
setups.disabled: The empty setup with DEV_AUTH false.
setups.two-owners-empty: Alice owns document_id at cursor 0; dev-bob owns foreign_document_id at cursor 0. Both tokens resolve distinct users.

client_defaults.note: Setups override these values explicitly. Apply response_assertions to every case. Wire cases do not attempt Automerge decoding except payload-decode-failure.

response_assertions.body_comparison: exact JSON value; null means no response bytes
response_assertions.required_headers: case-insensitive names; required values must match

request_generator_rules.replace_payload_with_repeated_byte: Deep-copy body; set changes[0].payload to canonical padded base64 of decoded_length copies of byte; serialize with JSON.stringify as UTF-8.
request_generator_rules.pad_json_with_spaces: Serialize body with JSON.stringify as UTF-8; append ASCII spaces until exactly utf8_length bytes. Reject an undersized length in the harness.
request_generator_rules.transport: When stream_body is true, send generated bytes as a stream without Content-Length; enforce the same size limit as a buffered request.
request_generator_rules.raw_body: Send literal UTF-8 bytes instead of serializing a body. Exactly one of body, raw_body, and body_generator may be present.
